text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—~~♪ —~~♪ 
Hmm hmm...♪ Whoops, sorry! After you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...As expected of 
Tap-san. 
Such exquisite, heart-pounding footwork 
you have.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am truly looking forward to your dance 
with Gimlet-san as well. 
...We will also do everything we can to 
liven things up, so please, do not worry.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Do not worry...? You saying I look 
nervous? Hey...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, whoa, whoa, what's that supposed 
to mean? 
Don't hold out on me. If there's something 
up, how about you spill it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... 
It was merely a figure of speech, so 
please pay it no mind.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Can't just let it slide like that. ...Come 
on! 
I'm not letting you go until you tell me 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I see. 
So that is the chronicle of last night.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The ball is veiled in silence, like a 
realm of ice, is it...? 
Without an audience, there is no one for 
us to intoxicate.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, unfortunately, that is the 
unvarnished reality. 
The executive committee is struggling with 
it as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. It just means we're still 
lacking charm. 
That's what you're trying to say, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Far from it. 
It's just that, since you asked, I felt it 
would be wrong to hide it...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... What a peculiar hermit we have 
here. 
Do you intend to ignite the devils with 
your hushed will?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, I don't quite understand 
what you mean...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No intention to unlock the casket of your 
true motives, then? 
Heh... Very well...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We shall do as we please. ...Right, Tap? 
Let us proclaim to all that a supernova 
has graced this ball!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Let's raise some serious hell! 
How does this sound? 
In the evening, from the rooftop—...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... 
Is it all right for me to overhear this?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't bother me one bit. 
It's just "how we're gonna make our move," 
after all. Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: No... it is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Everything should go according to your 
wishes—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Observation is... essential. 
This is also... to find my best partner...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ Hmm... easy compromises are 
a... NO. 
Failure is... not an option. My mission 
is... absolute.
(Chime—♪)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh? A broadcast... Is it an announcement?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah— Ah— Is this on? 
Hi everyone! How ya doing?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wait... what!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to the ligne droite Eve Festival! 
Let's get this party started! 
A special performance brought to you by 
this year's greatest dancers!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"We are the instigators of the 
phantasmagoric ball...! 
Allow us to bestow upon thee an invitation 
named enlightenment!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat!? What's going on, all the 
speakers at once!? 
Ah, a notification from Tap-senpai's 
UmaSta... A live stream...!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"AHAHAHA! If you wanna see it with your 
own eyes, get up to the roof! 
A tiny screen like that just won't cut it, 
right!?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tan-senpai and the others... Are you 
kidding me!? 
Oh crap! Is this even allowed!?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's not allowed! We have to 
stop them right now! 
Ugh, jeez, what a mess...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"HAAA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HAAA! 
Spin! Sneer! Scream! Get thoroughly drunk 
on meee!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"WOOO! No matter who says it's reckless, 
we're taking Best Dancer! 
You know it, don't you? Who else could it 
possibly be!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"We shall intoxicate all that exists! 
With this dance! With this passion! The 
proof of our spirit on the actual day 
shall far exceed this!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA! 
AHA-HA-HA-HA-HA!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's so hype...! 
Wait, what is with that set?! When did 
they even set that up... !?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
To think they could dance... like that... 
It's totally crazy... but... it's kinda... 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's with that...? They're just doing 
whatever they want to stand out. 
Something like this... Something like this 
is just...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What on earth... are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't I tell you? It's propaganda! 
We figured just showing them would be 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Just that...? 
You did all this—just for that?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What else do you need? 
If you think it's good, all you gotta do 
is follow your heart."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You get it, right? Feel it! Here we 
gooo—!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............! 
To think it would go... this far—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(This level of improvement, this wild 
enthusiasm. 
Did they know... it would turn out like 
this—?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No... did they just believe... in it—?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Heheheh... There is no need for 
understanding. 'Conviction' is an impulse 
of one's own that exists solely within 
oneself."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Conviction... comes from within...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What's the matter, Kris S? Is it really 
that complicated?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Or did you... get intimidated by our 
skills? 
You're entering too, right? I know you've 
been practicing all by yourself."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Is that—a provocation?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha, who knows? 
But after seeing that, you don't really 
have time to hesitate anymore, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Plan ahead... and trust my heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming... confidence. 
Is that... where your strength lies?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... Thank you so very much. 
I truly appreciate you making the 
arrangements on such short notice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As you know, I could never do something so 
bold myself. 
So please, be careful. Make sure no traces 
are left behind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, I wonder what will become of 
this.
